integrity: Exact algebraic proof with reproducible standard-library finite diagnostics; historical priority limited by accessible source coverage; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible birth-death-immigration chain; modes of stationary population counts only. No theorem on duration bimodality, extinction time, spatial networks, relative peak masses or deterministic bistability. Asymptotics fix normalized immigration eta below one.
title: Exact finite-capacity two-mode boundary for a logistic immigration population
